text: This manuscript is a narrative draft built around the locked Nature-series empirical package. It deliberately treats problem recognition and context-dependent representation as theoretical motivation rather than an identified mechanism. Before submission, the reference list should be expanded and converted to the target journal’s citation style; ethics/consent, data availability, code availability, author contributions, competing interests and funding statements should be added from the study records.
